objectives: To evaluate the prognostic significance of HSPs expression in colorectal cancer patients and its relationship with clinicopathological features, using a comprehensive and integrated meta-analysis of multiple HSP subtypes and their associations with major survival outcomes and clinicopathological features.
inclusion_criteria: (1) the original studies that were prospective or retrospective cohort studies and clinical trials; (2) studies that assessed the prognostic impact of HSPs on overall survival (OS), disease-free survival (DFS), progression-free survival (PFS), event-free survival (EFS), relapse-free survival (RFS), or cancer-specific survival (CSS) in patients with colorectal cancer; (3) studies provided data on the hazard ratio (HR) with a 95% confidence interval (CI), which could be either extracted directly from the studies or computed based on available data; (4) papers published in English; and (5) studies that have been fully published.
exclusion_criteria: (1) review articles, case reports, meeting abstracts, comments, letters, re-analyses, and animal studies; (2) studies lacking sufficient information to compute HRs and 95% CIs; (3) studies not providing survival data; and (4) studies with overlapping or duplicated data.
